propositions: The `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` date arguments and `--output json|text` format option, then render the full metric registry over the specified range

The command must wire the metrics entry point through a single explicit `if sub == "metrics":` dispatch arm in `_cli/__init__.py` on the reads path after store initialization, and register it as an individually-routed subcommand in the help-coverage guard

The command must hydrate the REGISTRY by importing the `rebar.metrics` package (not just the registry module) to trigger reader module registration side-effects, then evaluate every MetricSpec with a context carrying repo_root, since, and until
Each metric's evaluate result must be composed with its spec's lens field, and any exception during compute must be caught and rendered as unavailable rather than crashing the entire command

JSON output must be the default format containing metrics keyed by id with either value/source/confidence or unavailable/reason; `--output text` must produce a deterministic human-readable line per metric in registry order

The command source must not import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module (enforced by source-level scan), and all files (help text, overview, golden snapshots, generated CLI reference) must be created or regenerated to list metrics as a routable subcommand
